verdict.rationale: BigQuery release notes document an official Rust SDK, so the product does ship its own SDK. That SDK is only in Preview, though, and the pack does not document the breadth, stability or language coverage of BigQuery's SDK offering. The first-party Simba ODBC/JDBC drivers give official programmatic connectivity, but they are database drivers rather than SDKs and only partly support the story. Missing for 10: documentation of GA official SDKs in mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Java, Node, Go), SDK reference docs and examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
